dialogue.origin: （今日はロールプレイご一緒させて頂きありがとうございます。よろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for doing this role-play with me today. I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ本日のロールプレイよろしくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: The pleasure is all mine. I look forward to our role-play today.

dialogue.origin: 早速ですが始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.content: If you're ready, let's begin.

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願い致します
dialogue.content: I look forward to it.

dialogue.origin: こんばんは。相談員です。まず初めに年齢と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Good evening. I'm the counselor. To start, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 39歳女性です
dialogue.content: I'm a 39-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本日はどういった相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 子育てに悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm struggling with parenting.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: どういった内容でお悩みか詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you please tell me more about what specifically is troubling you?

dialogue.origin: はい、中3の息子がいます反抗期が酷くなりどうして良いのか分からないんです
dialogue.content: Yes, I have a son in his third year of junior high school. His rebellious phase has become so severe that I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 反抗期は難しいですものね。
dialogue.content: The rebellious phase can certainly be difficult.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どういった言動に困っておられますか？
dialogue.content: What kind of words or actions are you finding difficult?

dialogue.origin: まず朝起きません起こしても引っ張っても今日は休むと言います
dialogue.content: First, he won't get up in the morning. Even if I try to wake him or pull him out of bed, he just says, 'I'm taking the day off today.'

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 他にはどうですか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything else?

dialogue.origin: 高校は行かないで働きたいと言います
dialogue.content: He says he doesn't want to go to high school and wants to work instead.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: あなたはその発言を聞いてどう思われましたか？
dialogue.content: How did you feel when you heard him say that?

dialogue.origin: 高校は行かないと後で後悔すると思います
dialogue.content: I think he'll regret it later if he doesn't go to high school.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そう思われたのですね。
dialogue.content: I understand. That's how you feel.

dialogue.origin: 親としては当然かと思います
dialogue.content: I think that's natural for a parent to feel.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: そのことは息子さんにお伝えになられましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you told your son that?

dialogue.origin: はい、言いました
dialogue.content: Yes, I have.

dialogue.origin: 反応はいかがでしたか？
dialogue.content: What was his reaction?

dialogue.origin: やってみないと分からないと
dialogue.content: He said he won't know until he tries.

dialogue.origin: 「やってみないと」というのは受験をしてみないとということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: By 'trying,' does he mean trying to take the entrance exam?

dialogue.origin: いえ高校行かずに働いてみないと後悔するかどうかなんて分からないと
dialogue.content: No, he means he won't know if he'll regret it or not until he tries working without going to high school.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: その言葉を聞いてどう思われましたか？
dialogue.content: How did you feel when you heard those words?

dialogue.origin: 子供だから世の中の事を良く分かってないんだと思いました
dialogue.content: I thought to myself, 'He's just a child; he doesn't understand how the world works.'

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 親であり年長者だからこそ分かることもありますものね。
dialogue.content: Certainly, there are things you understand precisely because you're a parent and his elder.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: あなたは息子さんにどのように中学卒業後の人生を歩んでほしいとお考えですか？
dialogue.content: How would you like your son to live his life after graduating from junior high school?

dialogue.origin: 好きな人生を自分で選んで欲しいと思いますけど一応高校や大学は出ておかないと仕事の選択肢は狭まると思います
dialogue.content: I want him to choose a life he loves for himself, but I also think that if he doesn't at least graduate from high school or college, his job options will be limited.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 高校や大学を出てからの方が好きな人生を選べる選択肢が広がるのになと思っておられるのですね。
dialogue.content: So you feel that graduating from high school or university would broaden his options for choosing the life he wants.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: そのことは息子さんに伝えられましたか？
dialogue.content: Have you told your son that?

dialogue.origin: はい。もし今すごくやりたい事があるなら応援するけど無いみたいなのでそれなら高校は行っておきなさいと高校に行きながら考えなさいと言いました
dialogue.content: Yes. I told him that if there was something he was really passionate about doing right now, I would support him, but since there doesn't seem to be, he should go to high school and figure things out while he's there.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんはそのお言葉を聞いてどういう反応だったのですか？
dialogue.content: How did your son react when you said that?

dialogue.origin: 聞いてるのか聞いてないのかうっせ〜なあと言って、部屋に入ってしまいます
dialogue.content: I don't know if he was listening or not. He just said, 'You're so annoying,' and went into his room.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: あなたが一生懸命お気持ちを伝えてもそのような態度だと悲しくもなりますよね。
dialogue.content: It must be very disheartening when you try so hard to convey your feelings and are met with that kind of attitude.

dialogue.origin: はい、まだ話は終わってない！と声を荒げたら息子が2階に上がる階段の壁を蹴って壁に穴があきました
dialogue.content: Yes. When I raised my voice and said, 'We're not done talking!', he kicked the wall on the staircase on his way upstairs and made a hole in it.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: そのような雰囲気になると疲れてしまいますよね。
dialogue.content: That kind of atmosphere must be exhausting.

dialogue.origin: はい、どうすればいいのか分かりません
dialogue.content: Yes, I don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。今日はあなたのお気持ちを全て吐き出していただいて、一緒に考えていきましょうね。
dialogue.content: That's understandable. Today, please feel free to let out all of your feelings, and we'll think about this together.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: とんでもございません。
dialogue.content: Not at all.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんはどうしてそこまで高校進学を拒否していると思われますか？
dialogue.content: Why do you think your son is so opposed to going to high school?

dialogue.origin: 何となく劣等感があるのかなと思います。または、早く大人になりたい、働く事に憧れているという感じもします
dialogue.content: I have a feeling he may be struggling with feelings of inferiority. Or perhaps he wants to become an adult quickly—he seems to admire the idea of working.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. That makes sense.

dialogue.origin: 劣等感があるのかなというのはどういうところに思い当たりがありますか？
dialogue.content: What makes you think he might have feelings of inferiority?

dialogue.origin: 中2までタイに住んでいて高校入学に合わせて帰国予定が早まり1年で受験は大変だから一貫校にチャレンジしたら合格してでも周りはみんなすごくできる子ばっかりで
dialogue.content: We lived in Thailand until his second year of junior high. Our plan to return to Japan was moved up for his high school entrance. Since preparing for exams in just one year would be difficult, he applied for an integrated school and got in, but all the other kids there are extremely capable.

dialogue.origin: えぇ、そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: Oh, I see.

dialogue.origin: 授業についていくのが難しそうだなといった様子はありましたか？
dialogue.content: Did he seem like he was having a hard time keeping up with his classes?

dialogue.origin: はい。だから個別塾に行かせています。それも行ったり行かなかったりで
dialogue.content: Yes. That's why I'm having him go to a private tutor, but he goes inconsistently.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 個別塾は息子さんが行きたいとおっしゃったのですか？
dialogue.content: Was it your son's idea to go to the tutoring school?

dialogue.origin: 私が行った方がいいんじゃない？と言ったら分かったと言いました
dialogue.content: I suggested it might be a good idea for him to go, and he just said, 'Okay.'

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 通い始め当初はどういった様子で通われていましたか？
dialogue.content: How did he seem when he first started attending?

dialogue.origin: 1人で行っていたので良く分かりませんが、頑張る気持ちは見えました
dialogue.content: He went by himself, so I'm not entirely sure, but I could see he had the will to try.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 現在は中高一貫校ということでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So he's currently in a combined junior and senior high school, is that right?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: そうすると高校入学はエスカレーター式で高校に上がるか別の高校を受験するという手段があるのですか？
dialogue.content: So, does that mean he can get into the high school automatically, like an escalator system, or does he also have the option to take an entrance exam for a different high school?

dialogue.origin: 大体がエスカレーターなので受験はしなくていいんですなのに働きたいと言うので腹が立ちます希望すれば他を受験もできますがタイに居て、受験勉強が充分できていないので。
dialogue.content: Most students move up automatically, so he doesn't need to take an exam. That's why it's so frustrating when he says he wants to work. He could take exams for other schools if he wanted to, but since we were in Thailand, he hasn't been able to prepare adequately.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: せっかく一貫校に入学できたのにという気持ちもありますよね。
dialogue.content: You must feel like it's such a waste, after all the effort it took for him to get into that integrated school.

dialogue.origin: はい。受験の為に何度も帰国したり大変な思いをして、やっと合格したのに
dialogue.content: Yes. We went through so much, traveling back to Japan many times for the exams. It was incredibly difficult, and he finally passed, and yet...

dialogue.origin: そんなご苦労もされていたのですね。
dialogue.content: You went through all that hardship.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: それは思いが届いていないとやるせない気持ちにもなりますよね。
dialogue.content: It must be so frustrating and disheartening to feel that all your effort isn't getting through to him.

dialogue.origin: はい、とにかく偉そうなんです
dialogue.content: Yes. In any case, he's just so arrogant.

dialogue.origin: 言動が偉そうなのですか？
dialogue.content: Do you mean his words and behavior come across as arrogant?

dialogue.origin: はいうざっとかオレの人生はオレのもんだとかうるさいとか殆ど口をきかないし
dialogue.content: Yes. He says things like, 'You're so annoying,' 'My life is my own,' or 'Just be quiet,' and on top of that, he hardly talks to me at all.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんの人生を考えて一生懸命育ててこられたのにそう言われるとしんどいですよね。
dialogue.content: You've worked so hard to raise him with his future in mind, so it must be very painful to hear him say things like that.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 先程授業についていくのが難しそうなところがあると伺いましたが、息子さんの中学校での成績はいかがですか？
dialogue.content: You mentioned earlier that he seems to be having trouble keeping up in class. How are his grades in junior high?

dialogue.origin: 中の下くらいです
dialogue.content: They're somewhat below average.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: あなたはその成績をどう感じられましたか？
dialogue.content: How do you feel about those grades?

dialogue.origin: やればできるのに家に帰ったらTVやゲームや漫画ばっかり見てるからできないんだと思います。
dialogue.content: I think he could do better if he tried, but he can't because when he gets home, all he does is watch TV, play games, and read manga.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。もっとできるのにもったいないと思われているのですね。
dialogue.content: I see. You feel it's a waste because he has so much more potential.

dialogue.origin: はい。考えが甘いと思います
dialogue.content: Yes. I think his thinking is naive.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 難しい質問かも知れませんが、息子さんはご自身の成績をどう受け止めておられると思われますか？
dialogue.content: This may be a difficult question, but how do you think your son perceives his own grades?

dialogue.origin: 何も言いません成績も保護者面談で初めて知る感じで何も見せないので
dialogue.content: He doesn't say anything. I only find out about his grades at parent-teacher conferences because he doesn't show me anything.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 今までも成績は事前に伝えてなかったのですか？
dialogue.content: So has he not shared his grades with you beforehand in the past, either?

dialogue.origin: 中学1年の頃は見せてくれていました
dialogue.content: He used to show them to me when he was in his first year of junior high.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: 中学一年の頃の成績は今と同じくらいでしたか？
dialogue.content: Were his grades back then about the same as they are now?

dialogue.origin: 中間くらいでした
dialogue.content: They were about average.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 現在は中の下とおっしゃっていたので中一から比べると少し下がったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: You said his grades are below average now, so have they dropped a bit since his first year?

dialogue.origin: 今は学校のレベルが高いので難しいところもあるんだとは思います
dialogue.content: Well, the school he's at now is at a higher level, so I think that makes it more difficult for him.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。今の学校と一年生の学校では簡単には比べられないですものね。
dialogue.content: I see. It's not easy to compare his current school with the one from his first year, is it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Right.

dialogue.origin: そういったところで、もしかすると劣等感を抱いているのかもと思われているのですね。
dialogue.content: So that's another reason why you think he might be feeling a sense of inferiority.

dialogue.origin: そうですねでも話ができれば相談にものれますけど話にならないので
dialogue.content: That's right. If we could just talk, I could offer him advice, but we can't even have a proper conversation.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんは具体的にどういう風に卒業後働きたいとかは話されますか？
dialogue.content: Does your son say anything specific about what kind of work he wants to do after graduation?

dialogue.origin: なんでもやるって言うんです
dialogue.content: He just says he'll do 'anything.'

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: ”なんでも”ということは具体的には決まっていないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Does 'anything' mean he hasn't decided on anything specific?

dialogue.origin: はい、具体的に聞こうとするとうるさいって。
dialogue.content: Yes. When I try to ask for specifics, he just says, 'You're being annoying.'

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね。
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: イライラしてます。いつも
dialogue.content: He's always so irritated.

dialogue.origin: 大切な話なのに反抗的だと話が前に進みにくいですものね。
dialogue.content: It must be hard to move the conversation forward when he's so defiant about such an important topic.

dialogue.origin: 私もついイライラしてしまってそれもいけないんだと思います
dialogue.content: I end up getting irritated myself, and I know that's not good either.

dialogue.origin: そう思われているのですね。でもイライラするのも無理もないですよね。
dialogue.content: So that's how you feel. But it's certainly understandable that you would get irritated.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's true.

dialogue.origin: 息子さんに何かしたいことがあるなら応援するから具体的なプランを教えてほしい、それが言えないなら賛成できないよと伝えるとどうなると思われますか？
dialogue.content: What do you think would happen if you told your son, 'If there's something you really want to do, I'll support you, but I need you to show me a concrete plan. If you can't do that, then I can't agree to this'?

dialogue.origin: そうですね最近冷静にそんな会話ができていなかったので試してみます。
dialogue.content: You're right. We haven't been able to have a calm conversation like that recently. I'll give it a try.

dialogue.origin: すみません、お時間になってしまいましたね。本日はロールプレイにお付き合いいただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: I'm sorry, but it looks like our time is up. Thank you for participating in this role-play with me today.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。お手数ですが評価もよろしくお願い致します。それでは失礼いたします。
dialogue.content: Thank you. If you wouldn't mind providing an evaluation, I would appreciate it. Goodbye.

topic.sub: 子育てにおける親子のコミュニケーション問題
